info.title: The Selling Partner API for Action Items
info.description: The Selling Partner API for Action Items enables you to discover and inspect action items surfaced by Amazon, including recommendations, issues, and tasks.

get.description: Retrieve a paginated, filterable list of action items for the selling partner. When you specify multiple filters, only action items that match all of them are returned. When you specify multiple values for one filter, action items that match any of those values are returned.

parameters.name: typeDefinitionIds
parameters.description: Filter by action item type definition IDs. Multiple values allowed.

parameters.name: updatedAfter
parameters.description: Retrieve items last updated at or after this time. When used with `updatedBefore`, this value must be earlier than `updatedBefore`.

parameters.name: updatedBefore
parameters.description: Retrieve items last updated at or before this time. When used with `updatedAfter`, this value must be later than `updatedAfter`.

parameters.name: includedData
parameters.description: A list of optional datasets to include in the response. When omitted, only core action item fields are returned.

GetActionItemResponse.description: The response schema for the `getActionItem` operation.

ActionItem.description: A specific actionable item surfaced to a selling partner. Can be a recommendation (an opportunity to pursue), an issue (a problem to fix), or a task (a mid-execution prompt requiring seller action).

actionItemId.description: Uniquely and permanently identifies the action item throughout its lifecycle.

type.description: The structured classification of this action item and a reference to the definition it instantiates.

description.description: A localized explanation of why Amazon is surfacing this action item.

status.description: The current state of the action item. A list that combines its lifecycle state with the capabilities currently available on it. For example, `AUTOMATABLE`, `DISMISSABLE`.

impacts.description: The business impacts associated with this action item. Each impact is classified as a cost, benefit, or enforcement and may carry quantified estimates. Only returned when `includedData` contains `impacts`.

resolutions.description: The available ways the selling partner can act on this action item. Returned in priority order (first entry is the recommended resolution). Only returned when `includedData` contains `resolutions`.

references.description: The entities this action item applies to. Only returned when `includedData` contains `references`.

lastUpdatedDate.description: When the action item was last updated. In [ISO 8601](https://developer-docs.amazon/sp-api/docs/iso-8601) date-time format.

dueDate.description: The date by which action must be taken. Items past this date transition to `OVERDUE` status. Absent means no due date.

ActionItemType.description: The structured classification of an action item and a reference to the definition it instantiates.

classifications.description: One or more classifications for this action item.

definition.description: A reference to the versioned action item definition this item is an instance of.

ActionItemTypeDefinition.description: A reference to the versioned action item definition, with a localized display name.

typeDefinitionId.description: The semantic identifier of the action item definition. For example, `AFN_CROSS_STORE_EXPANSION`.

displayName.description: Localized display name of the definition.

LocalizedText.description: A localized text value paired with the locale it is rendered in.

ActionItemStatuses.description: The state of an action item, expressed as a list combining lifecycle state with currently available capabilities.

ActionItemStatus.description: A state or capability of an action item. `PENDING_SELLING_PARTNER`, `DISMISSED`, `SNOOZED`, `OVERDUE`, `ACTIONED`, and `RESOLVED` are lifecycle states; `AUTOMATABLE`, `DISMISSABLE`, and `SNOOZABLE` express available capabilities.

ActionItemTypeClassifications.description: A list of action item classifications.

ActionItemTypeClassification.description: The classification of an action item.

ActionItemImpacts.description: The business impacts associated with an action item.

Impact.description: A typed impact associated with an action item, classified as a cost, benefit, or enforcement, and optionally quantified with one or more estimates.

definition.description: Reference to the impact type definition, with a localized display name.

description.description: Optional localized description specific to this impact line.

x-docgen-enum-table-extension.description: A negative financial impact to the selling partner.
A positive financial impact or growth opportunity.
An enforcement action taken or pending by Amazon.

ImpactDefinitionRef.description: A reference to an impact type definition with a localized display name.

impactDefinitionId.description: Machine-readable identifier of the impact type. For example, `REFERRAL_FEE`, `POTENTIAL_SALES_LIFT`.

Estimate.description: A quantified estimate for an impact. If value is present it is a single-point estimate; if minimum and maximum are present it is a range.

x-docgen-enum-table-extension.description: A monetary amount. Requires `currencyCode`.
A percentage value.
A dimensionless count or quantity.

value.description: A single-point estimate value. Present when the estimate is not a range.

minimum.description: The lower bound of a range estimate.

maximum.description: The upper bound of a range estimate.

currencyCode.description: ISO 4217 currency code. Present when `type` is `MONEY`.

definition.description: Reference to the estimate's type definition, with a localized display name.

EstimateDefinitionRef.description: A reference to an estimate type definition with a localized display name.

estimateDefinitionId.description: Machine-readable identifier of the estimate type. For example, `CATEGORY_REFERRAL_RATE`, `NINETY_DAY_SALES_LIFT`.

Resolutions.description: The available ways the selling partner can act on an action item. Returned in priority order; the first entry is the recommended resolution.

Resolution.description: An end state that resolves the action item. The resolution itself is identified by `definition.resolutionDefinitionId`. The type names the top-level mechanism for reaching that end state (for example, `EXPAND_CROSS_STORE`), and each mechanism offers one or more pathways to accomplish it: the seller can perform it themselves with the `url` and/or have Amazon automate it with `actionPlans`; a resolution always offers at least one of these pathways. The optional description carries localized instructions for the resolution as a whole; for text specific to one action plan, refer to `ActionPlanReference.description`.

url.description: Pathway for the selling partner to accomplish this resolution themselves: a URL to an existing experience. Optional; present when a manual pathway is available.

actionPlans.description: Automated pathways for accomplishing this resolution. Each entry references an action plan template that Amazon can run to reach this resolution's end state.

ResolutionType.description: The top-level mechanism for reaching this resolution's end state, expressed as a verb (for example, `EXPAND_CROSS_STORE`). This is an open string: additional resolution types may be introduced over time without a new API version, so clients should tolerate unrecognized values rather than fail deserialization. Known values are documented below. Each mechanism offers one or more pathways to accomplish it: the seller can perform it themselves with the `url`, or have Amazon carry it out with an automated action plan (`actionPlans`).

x-docgen-enum-table-extension.description: Expand the seller's catalog into another store.

ResolutionDefinitionRef.description: Details of a resolution, drawn from a catalog of resolution definitions that can be shared across action item types.

resolutionDefinitionId.description: Machine-readable identifier of the resolution definition (the change this resolution produces).

displayName.description: Localized display name of the resolution.

References.description: Entities referenced by an action item.

catalogs.description: Catalog references associated with the action item.

actionPlans.description: The most recent action plan associated with this action item, if any. To find every plan for an item, call `listActionPlans` with `actionItemIds`.

CatalogReference.description: A reference to a catalog, scoped to one or more Amazon stores.

marketplaceIds.description: The Amazon store identifiers to which this catalog reference applies.

ActionPlanReference.description: A reference to an action plan offered by a resolution. `actionPlanTemplateId` identifies the plan template; `actionPlanId` identifies the created plan instance once one exists; `url` optionally deep-links to the action plan experience for this template; `description` optionally carries localized text for this plan, distinguishing it from other action plans offered on the same resolution.

actionPlanTemplateId.description: The identifier of the plan template.

actionPlanId.description: The identifier of the created plan instance, when one exists. Optional; the backend may not populate it yet.

url.description: Optional deep link to the action plan experience for this template.

ErrorList.description: A list of error responses returned when a request is unsuccessful.

Error.description: Error response returned when the request is unsuccessful.

code.description: An error code that identifies the type of error that occurred.

message.description: A message that describes the error condition.

details.description: Additional details that can help the caller understand or fix the issue.

ListActionItemsResponse.description: The response schema for the `listActionItems` operation.

actionItems.description: The action items matching the query, as full `ActionItem` objects.

refinements.description: Facet counts for progressive filtering across the full filtered result set. Only returned when `includedData` contains `refinements`.

nextToken.description: A token to retrieve the next page of results. Absent when there are no more results.

previousToken.description: A token to retrieve the previous page of results. Absent on the first page.

SearchRefinements.description: Search refinements (facets) for progressive filtering. Maps a refinement key (for example, status, classifications) to its available values with counts in the full filtered result set.

SearchRefinementValues.description: The list of refinement values for a given refinement key.

SearchRefinementValue.description: A refinement value with its count in the full filtered result set.

displayName.description: Human-readable label for the refinement value.

count.description: Number of results matching this refinement value.

value.description: The refinement value to pass back as a filter.

DismissActionItemRequest.description: Request body for dismissing an action item.

reason.description: The reason for dismissing the action item.

DismissalReason.description: The reason a selling partner is dismissing an action item.

reasonTypes.description: One or more reasons for dismissing the action item.

x-docgen-enum-table-extension.description: The action item is not applicable to the selling partner.
The selling partner is not interested in pursuing the action item.

DismissActionItemResponse.description: The response schema for the `dismissActionItem` operation.

actionItemId.description: The identifier of the dismissed action item.

status.description: The action item's status after dismissal; contains `DISMISSED`.
